name: google-hotels-scraper
title: Google Hotels Scraper & API: Price Tracker & Comparison
description: Use to export Google Hotels nightly prices for a city search over a range of check-in dates. Input: a search such as "hotels in Paris", dates or days ahead, nights, guests, currency. Returns one row per hotel and date, plus optional booking-site offers. $1.99 per 1,000 hotel prices.
